elements.name: A1_T1
elements.html: Please spend a few minutes exploring the tool before beginning the survey. Click the icon in your browser toolbar near the top-right corner of the browser window. Be sure to view all parts of the interface.

elements.name: A1_Q1
elements.title: Briefly describe (1-2 sentences), what do you think is the purpose of this tool?

elements.name: A1_Q2
elements.title: Please list the new information, if any, you learned by using this tool.

elements.name: A1_Q3
elements.title: Please list the information you already knew, if any, that the tool told you.

elements.name: A1_Q4

elements.name: A1_Q5
elements.title: What questions, if any, do you have about what you saw in the tool?

elements.name: A9_T1
elements.html: You have now been using the ADA extension, referred to as the “system” below, for the past week. This section presents a set of general statements about your overall experience interacting with it. Drawing on your usage over this period, please select the answer choice that best describes your agreement or disagreement with each statement.

elements.name: A9_Q1
elements.title: Please rate your agreement with each statement.

rows.text: I think that I would like to use this system frequently.
I found the system unnecessarily complex.
I thought the system was easy to use.
I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system.
I found the various functions in this system were well-integrated.
I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system.
I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly.
I found the system very cumbersome to use.
I felt very confident using the system.
I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system.
